payload.blocks: Phase 1 (fgos authority locate) cannot land, and through it phases 5, 7 and 11.
payload.headline: Add apps/fgos/src/main.rs and test/cli/subcommand-flag-drift.test.mjs to the authority-doors footprint for the new verb?

parts.cause: main.rs:139 and :385 register convention, the pattern the plan copies. cargo test -p fgos --test authority fails with "operation authority.locate not found in catalog" (lead ran it on branch component-authority-doors/p01). subcommand-flag-drift.test.mjs:192 asserts the exact native verb list. Report: plans/261121-2110-component-authority-doors/reports/unit-261123-0819-p01-result.md.

options.cost: Two footprint lines, about 2 lines of Rust and about 5 lines of test.
options.does: The planner or supervisor adds apps/fgos/src/main.rs and test/cli/subcommand-flag-drift.test.mjs to the plan footprint (phases 1 and 5). A fix unit adds the two registration lines and the authority entries in the drift test.
options.gain: The verb works as the plan intends, and phase 1 lands today.
options.harm: main.rs is a shared file. A running plan that also holds it would make admission wait.
options.label: A. Add both files to the footprint

options.cost: About 100 lines across main.rs and wiring, plus a new item.
options.does: Moves provider registration out of main.rs into a list in wiring/mod.rs that main.rs reads.
options.gain: Later verbs no longer touch main.rs.
options.harm: This is a refactor of every verb's registration, outside this plan's purpose (RUL104), and main.rs still has to change once.
options.label: B. Move the registration to wiring/mod.rs

parts.recommendation: A: it is the existing pattern, it is two lines, and it is the smallest change that makes the planned verb real.

scope.allows: Adding those two files to the footprint of plan 261121-2110-component-authority-doors (phases 1 and 5), only for registering and listing the authority verb.
scope.forbids: Any other change to main.rs, and any other footprint change; the phases 2-3 question q-swxkda2x5r is separate.

parts.what: Phase 1 built the fgos-component-authority crate (7 tests pass), the verb wiring and the registry entry. Two files outside the plan footprint must also change for any new native verb: apps/fgos/src/main.rs registers its descriptor and provider, and test/cli/subcommand-flag-drift.test.mjs pins the list of native verbs. Without them the verb is unserved and npm test is red.
